20066.name: Newspaper House Swindon
20066.description: Newspaper House is a part conversion and part new build project.  Site A was used as offices with a large warehous to the rear - we have part of the warehouse to demolish and then the remaining space to soft strip - we then create 12x Commercial Retail Units and 39x 1 & 2 Bed Apartments.  Site B was another warehouse that is situated to the rear (seperate) this is to be demolished and we are building 3x 3 Bed Houses & 11x 1 & 2 Bed Apartments. Site C was their power and plant station - this is to be demolished and we are building some office space and the bin and bike store for Site A.
